headline: Raising fuel reserves to 90 days: the challenge is not just building storage
summary: Oil prices are rising as Middle East tensions escalate and Strait of Hormuz shipping remains under pressure. Vietnam's goal of 90 days of net import reserves requires storage plus purchasing and rotation mechanisms.
why: Strategic fuel reserves buffer importing economies against supply shocks, affecting fuel demand, refining margins and energy import costs.
